cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Build a Coalition
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to your side so your position appears broader and more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've added my name to your pottery-class list. Put us both on the request for late opening; two classes will carry more weight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's my attendance sheet. I leave at five; late opening doesn't help me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, checking who's here. Will you join the request anyway? It shouldn't look like one evening student's favour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Ask for weekend access too. The morning class would come in for that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Add weekends, then. Bring two of them with you and we'll ask as a group.
